newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy completes major evacuation from Albania.
newsitem.headline: Italy completes major evacuation from Albania.

text.p: Italy said on Friday it had completed an operation to evacuate from Albania around 1,000 foreigners and some Albanians.

A foreign ministry spokesman said the operation, involving ships and helicopters and coordinated on the spot by the ambassador in Tirana, began on Thursday afternoon and was completed early on Friday.

The ministry said two Italian navy ships, the San Giorgio and San Giusto, had left the Albanian port of Durres with around 900 people on board, including 200 Italian citizens, after an overnight operation suspended briefly due to fog.
Two army helicopters had also flown to Tirana from the southern port of Brindisi to airlift 94 people out of the Albanian capital. They were returning directly to Brindisi.
The ministry said the 94 included 50 Italians, 12 Russians and the remainder from several other countries.
Some small groups of Italians remained in Albania and the ministry said a further evacuation could be arranged if and when they decided they wanted to leave the country.
